name: dropdown
title: Dropdown
description: Opens a short list of actions or values from a button.

props.name: trigger
props.description: The element that opens the menu. Rendered with `asChild`, so pass a Button.

props.name: modal
props.description: Modal menus block the rest of the page while open.

props.name: aria-label
props.description: Accessible name for the menu, when the trigger's text doesn't say enough.

props.name: onFocusOutside
props.description: Focus moved outside a non-modal menu; call `preventDefault()` to keep it open.

DropdownMenuGroup.description: A titled group of items (Figma `_dropdown/group`). Groups get a rule between them.

MenuItemContent.description: What sits inside a menu row: icon, label and description, then shortcut and check.

props.name: icon
props.description: Leading icon. 16px by default; stacked two-line items may use 20px (`iconSize={20}`).

props.name: selected
props.description: Marks the current value: a trailing check.

props.name: shortcut
props.description: Keys that run the item, e.g. "⌘N", shown on the right (Figma's `showShortcut`).

props.name: renderLabel
props.description: Wraps the label, e.g. in Radix Select's `ItemText`.
